package.description: macOS-style screen capture for Windows with drag-and-drop as the primary action.

en-US.description: macOS-style screen capture for Windows with drag-and-drop as the primary action.
en-US.longDescription: wsnap is a native Windows capture tool that makes drag-and-drop the primary action: capture a region, get a floating thumbnail, then drag it out as a real file (path in terminals, file in Explorer/chat/upload fields) or click to copy the path. Includes a minimal editor (arrow/rect/pen/text/mosaic/crop), on-device OCR (KO/EN), region GIF recording, scroll capture, and clipboard watch. PerMonitorV2 DPI-correct.
en-US.name: wsnap
